description: This file defines the class SugarpdfSmarty, a helper class for generating PDFs using Smarty templates within the SuiteCRM system. It extends a base class Sugarpdf and manages Smarty template rendering for PDF output.

classes.name: SugarpdfSmarty
classes.description: A helper class extending Sugarpdf to generate PDF documents from Smarty templates, allowing customization of template location and Smarty variables.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the PDF by disabling headers and footers, and initializing the Smarty instance.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the PDF content by fetching the Smarty template and writing its HTML output to the document.

methods.name: _initSmartyInstance
methods.description: Initializes the Sugar_Smarty object if not already instantiated, and assigns global language strings.
